codes.location.accuracy: Accuracy is missing or larger than max_accuracy_m
codes.location.stale: fix_time is missing, older than max_age_s plus clock_skew_s, or in the future
codes.location.mock: is_mock is true and mock_location is reject
codes.location.ip_country: The IP country does not match and ip_country is reject
codes.location.reference_not_matched: The place rule failed and on_mismatch is reject

codes.liveness.video_too_long: The video is longer than max_video_seconds plus one second
codes.liveness.video_unreadable: The server cannot read the video duration
